papers.title: Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners
papers.abstract: People often tackle difficult problems by thinking more deeply or exploring more possibilities. Similarly, recursive reasoners, which reason by repeatedly applying a learned update rule to latent states, can also scale inference through more updates (depth) or additional trajectories generated by perturbing latent states (width). When people hit a dead end in their thinking, they may step back and approach the problem from a fresh angle. However, neither depth scaling nor perturbation-based width scaling of recursive reasoners can reliably achieve this: both may converge to incorrect attractors. To address this, we propose to explore diverse reasoning traces by applying different update maps to the same latent state, without any additional training. We realize this idea through \emph{Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)}, which searches over input conditions to induce alternative update maps from the pretrained reasoner. Across six reasoning tasks, ICS achieves the highest mean accuracy, while requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer model FLOPs than the evaluated scaling baselines. Controlled experiments confirm that ICS can redirect trajectories from the same state. Our theoretical analysis and rigorous numerical verification also confirm that ICS can locally eliminate incorrect attracting fixed points. Together, these findings establish ICS as an effective axis for efficient test-time scaling and motivate further research on shaping recursive reasoning during training and at test time.

papers.title_zh: 面向递归推理器高效测试时扩展的输入条件搜索
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出递归推理器（对隐状态反复施加同一学习到的更新规则）的两种测试时扩展方式——增加更新步数的深度扩展与扰动隐状态生成多轨迹的宽度扩展——都会收敛到错误的吸引子，无法像人一样“换角度重想”。为此作者提出 Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)，不增加任何训练，而是搜索输入条件以诱导预训练递归推理器产生不同的 update map，从而在同一个隐状态上探索多样的推理轨迹。在六个推理任务上 ICS 取得最高平均准确率，且所需模型 FLOPs 比所对比的扩展基线最多少两个数量级；控制实验证实 ICS 能把轨迹从同一状态重定向，理论分析与严格数值验证进一步表明 ICS 可局部消除错误的吸引不动点。
innovations: 提出 Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)：通过对输入条件做搜索，从预训练递归推理器中诱导出替代的 update map，实现同一隐状态上的多轨迹多样推理，全程无需额外训练
揭示并论证深度扩展与基于扰动的宽度扩展都会收敛到错误 attractor 的失效机理，将 ICS 确立为一条独立且高效的测试时扩展新轴

提供理论分析 + 严格数值验证证明 ICS 能局部消除错误的吸引不动点，并通过控制实验明确展示其可从同一隐状态重定向推理轨迹
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于以隐状态迭代递归推理的模型（循环深度推理器）在部署阶段的推理效率与正确率权衡，面向数学、逻辑等需要反复迭代思考的测试时推理服务与算力受限的推理加速场景。

papers.title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

papers.title_zh: TempoKV：面向自回归视频生成的可预测 KV 缓存量化
papers.summary_cn: 自回归视频扩散模型能流式生成长视频，但不断增长的 KV 缓存带来显著显存开销，而已有的 KV 量化方法主要面向 LLM，迁移到视频模型后因激活统计分布不同、时空冗余强而效果不佳。作者观察到视频 KV 缓存随时间高度可预测且存在明显不对称性：Key 可由其时间历史高度预测，而 Value 主要依赖当前 Key 并只需少量前置 Value 历史。为此提出免训练的预测式 KV 缓存量化框架 TempoKV，按 K 与 V 各自不同的依赖关系分别预测，仅以低精度存储残差；两个预测器都很轻量，通过在一小批 BF16 样本上做一次离线线性回归标定后固定，跨 prompt 与生成轮次复用。在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 LongCat-Video-13B 上，TempoKV 在相当或更高压缩比下生成质量持续优于现有 KV 量化方法，最高实现 6.71 倍 KV 缓存压缩并取得最佳质量-效率权衡。
innovations: 发现视频 KV 缓存的时间可预测性及其不对称性：Key 沿时间历史高度可预测，Value 仅依赖当前 Key 与极短历史，这一统计规律与 LLM 的 KV 特性不同。
提出免训练预测式量化框架 TempoKV，对 Key 与 Value 按各自依赖分别做预测并只低精度存储残差，而非直接量化原始 KV。
预测器为轻量线性回归模型，仅需在小规模 BF16 样本上离线标定一次并固定，跨 prompt 和多次生成复用，无需在线适配。

papers.scenario_cn: 面向需要长时间流式生成的视频扩散服务，用于缓解自回归视频生成在显存受限 GPU 上的 KV 缓存膨胀问题，使长视频/连续生成可在有限显存预算下持续推理。

papers.title: Legal-R1: Agentic Retrieval for Evidence-Based Legal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Legal question answering requires answers that are not only plausible, but also grounded in legally valid and citable evidence. Standard retrieval-augmented generation often relies on one-shot semantic matching, which is insufficient when legal evidence must be selected according to authority, applicability, and diversity across heterogeneous sources. We introduce Legal-R1, an agentic retrieval framework for evidence-based legal reasoning. Legal-R1 decomposes legal reasoning into a multi-agent workflow, where a Lawyer agent learns when to retrieve, which legal source to query, what evidence to seek, and when the collected evidence is sufficient. A Legal Assistant agent retrieves from normative legal sources and precedent cases with authority-aware and diversity-aware selection, while a Judge agent generates the final answer from the complete evidence trajectory. We post-train only the Lawyer agent with masked supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple Chinese legal benchmarks show that Legal-R1 improves over general-purpose, legal-specific, and retrieval-augmented baselines.

papers.title_zh: Legal-R1：面向证据化法律推理的智能体检索框架
papers.summary_cn: 针对法律问答不仅要求答案合理、还要有法律上有效且可引用的证据这一问题，论文指出标准 RAG 的一次性语义匹配无法按权威性、适用性和跨异构来源的多样性来筛选法律证据，因此提出 Legal-R1——一个面向证据化法律推理的 agentic 检索框架。Legal-R1 把法律推理拆成多智能体工作流：Lawyer agent 学习何时检索、查询哪个法律来源、寻找何种证据以及证据何时充分；Legal Assistant agent 在规范性法律来源与判例两类异构语料上做权威性感知与多样性感知的证据选取；Judge agent 基于完整证据轨迹生成最终答案。作者仅对 Lawyer agent 用掩码监督微调加轨迹感知强化学习做后训练，在多个中文法律基准上优于通用模型、法律专用模型与 RAG 基线。
innovations: 把法律推理显式建模为 Lawyer / Legal Assistant / Judge 三角色多智能体工作流，并将“是否检索、查哪个来源、找什么证据、何时停止”作为可学习的检索决策交给 Lawyer agent。
在 Legal Assistant 中引入 authority-aware（权威性感知）与 diversity-aware（多样性感知）的证据选择策略，同时覆盖规范性法律条文与判例两类异构来源。
后训练仅更新 Lawyer agent（masked SFT + trajectory-aware RL），不训练其余 agent，显著降低训练成本。
在多个中文法律基准上同时超过通用模型、法律专用模型以及 RAG 检索增强基线。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向需要给出可引用、可追溯法律依据的中文法律问答与法律咨询系统，解决普通 RAG 单次语义匹配难以兼顾条文权威性与证据覆盖度、导致回答不可采信的问题，可落地于法律检索、判例分析与合规问答等业务。

papers.title: X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning
papers.abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. To address this, we propose X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented reinforcement learning that decouples learned auxiliary-evidence seeking from validity-gated quantitative measurement acquisition for evidence-grounded CXR reasoning. We construct Rad-CoT, a 7.7K-sample corpus combining causally ordered tool-augmented trajectories with report-style diagnostic reasoning, and use it to initialize Qwen3-VL-8B via agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We then optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an accuracy-gated reward that applies process-level terms for measurement consistency and auxiliary-tool cost only to correct trajectories, preventing plausible process behavior from compensating for an incorrect diagnosis. Across three CXR benchmarks, X-Ragent achieves the strongest results, including an 8.6-point improvement on the fully held-out ChestAgentBench. By seeking evidence selectively and admitting only valid measurements, X-Ragent supports more faithful and evidence-grounded CXR reasoning.

papers.title_zh: X-Ragent：面向证据锚定胸部 X 光推理的工具增强强化学习
papers.summary_cn: 胸部 X 光（CXR）判读需要在视觉所见之外整合任务相关的辅助证据，而现有工具增强医疗智能体缺少“何时该调用工具”的学习机制，也无法阻止不适用的定量证据进入诊断推理。作者提出 X-Ragent 后训练框架，把可学习的辅助证据寻求与经有效性门控的定量测量获取解耦，并构建 Rad-CoT 数据集（7.7K 条因果排序的工具增强轨迹配报告式诊断推理）对 Qwen3-VL-8B 做 agentic SFT 初始化，再用 GRPO 与 accuracy-gated reward 优化策略。该奖励把测量一致性与辅助工具成本等过程级项仅施加于诊断正确的轨迹上，防止过程看似合理却掩盖错误结论。在三个 CXR 基准上取得最佳结果，全留出的 ChestAgentBench 上提升 8.6 分。
innovations: X-Ragent 后训练框架显式解耦两件事：学习“是否需要寻求辅助证据”，以及对定量测量获取做有效性门控，避免不适用测量污染诊断推理。
构建 Rad-CoT 数据集（7.7K 样本），将因果排序的工具增强轨迹与报告式诊断推理配对，用于 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 agentic 监督微调初始化。
提出 accuracy-gated reward：测量一致性与辅助工具成本等过程级奖励只在诊断正确的轨迹上生效，阻断“过程合理”对错误诊断的补偿。
在三个 CXR 基准上均取得最强结果，完全留出的 ChestAgentBench 上较基线提升 8.6 个百分点，验证选择性取证与仅接纳有效测量的效果。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向临床胸部 X 光辅助判读：智能体需自主判断何时调用外部模块取证、并拒绝无效定量测量，适用于可集成测量与检索工具的多模态医学诊断智能体及阅片辅助系统。

papers.title: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

提出 ANTE-TTO 测试时优化，利用已训练的前瞻预测在候选动作间选择，无需任何外部打分器即可实现 test-time scaling。
实验发现：Qwen3-32B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 由 25.0% 升至 57.2%（高于匹配 GRPO 基线 6.2 个百分点），世界模型预测准确率在 RL 中由 44% 提升到 69%，且前瞻能力可跨 harness 与分布外域迁移。

papers.title: An Optical KV Cache Network for Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Disaggregated LLM serving moves each request's KV cache from a prefill GPU to a decode GPU before the response begins, and a coding-agent turn often moves the KV of its whole long context. Behind an oversubscribed packet fabric this transfer adds to time to first token (TTFT). An optical circuit switch (OCS) can give every transfer a full-rate circuit for less than an oversubscribed packet fabric costs, but a mechanical OCS needs tens of milliseconds to reconfigure. We hide this delay inside the prefill. A reservation scheduler commits each circuit while the prefill is still computing, so the circuit is ready when the KV is, and each GPU reaches the OCS over its own wavelength-multiplexed (WDM) optics on one fiber pair. In simulations of GPU clusters on real serving traces with measured prefill times on H100 GPUs, this optical KV cache network matches 400G packet fabrics with adaptive routing at 0.55 to 0.78 times the cost of a 2:1 fabric and tolerates the 50 ms reconfiguration delay of a 384-port mechanical OCS.

Behind an oversubscribed packet fabric this transfer adds to time to first token (TTFT). An optical circuit switch (OCS) can give every transfer a full-rate circuit for less than an oversubscribed packet fabric costs, but a mechanical OCS needs tens of milliseconds to reconfigure. We hide this delay inside the prefill. A reservation scheduler commits each circuit while the prefill is still computing, so the circuit is ready when the KV is, and each GPU reaches the OCS over its own wavelength-multiplexed (WDM) optics on one fiber pair. In simulations of GPU clusters on real serving traces with measured prefill times on H100 GPUs, this optical KV cache network matches 400G packet fabrics with adaptive routing at 0.55 to 0.78 times the cost of a 2:1 fabric and tolerates the 50 ms reconfiguration delay of a 384-port mechanical OCS.

papers.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
papers.abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

papers.title: Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization
papers.abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.

papers.title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at this https URL .

papers.summary_cn: 论文研究多智能体系统中非前缀 KV cache 复用失效的问题：当各 agent 任务相互冲突时，直接跨 agent 复用非前缀 KV cache 会使模型性能最多下降 90%，而选择性重计算（selective recomputation）与基于偏移的校准（offset-based calibration）等已有补救手段只能挽回有限损失。作者认为问题不只在被污染的 KV 表示，还在于目标 agent 难以在自己的指令下解读被复用的上下文，据此提出 LatentRemedy：用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后一个隐状态映射为少量任务条件化的 latent token，置于被复用的 KV 块之后与共享上下文交互，从而无需重算共享块；该 MLP 通过 full-prefill 蒸馏训练以把后续预测导向目标任务。实验显示 LatentRemedy 在冲突任务上持续优于现有复用基线，且随着 cache 规模增大 TTFT 仍接近直接复用。

papers.title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. papers.title: ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

papers.title: Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

papers.title: FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Video large language models (Video LLMs) encode each frame into hundreds of visual tokens, making video inference expensive. Existing methods reduce this cost through similarity-based merging or attention-based selection but face two challenges: Hierarchy-blind Pruning, which overlooks regional compressibility and can discard critical evidence, and Attention Drift, where positional effects and attention sinks shift text-to-vision attention away from task relevance. We propose FoveaTree, a two-stage, training-free visual-token pruning framework. First, Merge-Gain Density Estimation measures the feature distortion caused by regional merging and constructs a quadtree-derived density map to guide token dropping, merging, and retention. Second, Attention Tree Pruning uses the surviving units and inherited tree topology to refine text-to-vision attention in intermediate LLM layers, preserving relevant regional evidence while removing low-relevance content. We evaluate FoveaTree on InternVL3.5-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B across five video question-answering benchmarks and one captioning benchmark at 50%, 30%, and 10% visual-token retention. FoveaTree consistently achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across the evaluated settings, offering a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

papers.title: From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReState exhibits strong adaptability across different MLLM backbones and achieves strong performance on multiple public reasoning benchmarks, supporting the shift from stage-centric reasoning toward state-centric reasoning. papers.title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
papers.abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at this https URL

papers.title: EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution, the attack preserves normal functionality and stays nearly inactive before evolution (0.5% attack success rate), yet exceeds 95% attack success within 100 interactions, revealing a stealthy threat unique to self-evolving agents.

papers.title: Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Exploration bounds learning efficiency in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Current methods explore mostly through independent sampling, without fully using the information gathered along the way, such as known wrong answers and environment feedback. We propose LEAF, which injects a dynamic, problem-specific memory into the context before every rollout. The memory contains the most recent response, its reward, and other environment feedback. It is updated after every verifier call. We decouple policy updates from rollouts and update the policy through self-distillation. On four benchmarks and two open models, LEAF accelerates exploration by about 4x compared with a random sampling baseline. On unseen test sets, it improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by 1.59 and 1.83 percentage points on the two models, while using less compute than any RL baseline. These results highlight the potential of LEAF in improving both exploration and learning efficiency. Code is available at: this https URL

papers.title: RECAP: Calibrating Low-Bit Reasoning Models on the History They Read
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the cost of serving reasoning models but can substantially degrade long chains of thought. Each step reads cached keys and values spanning thousands of tokens, allowing quantization errors to accumulate along the trajectory. Standard calibration operates on short segments that omit the earlier context needed by later reasoning steps. Even when this context is retained, cache reconstruction error alone does not capture how quantization errors affect subsequent attention. We present RECAP, a post-training quantization method that calibrates reasoning models on the history they read. Dynamic-prefix calibration separates long historical context from short-block reconstruction. It regenerates prefix keys and values with the current quantizer and rotates the active block to supervise every position along the trajectory. Prefix read geometry further supervises historical cache errors according to their effects on attention outputs, weighting key and value errors asymmetrically. With both components applied only during calibration, RECAP outperforms the baseline across multiple reasoning models and quantization settings. Under W4A4KV4, RECAP improves accuracy over the baseline by 13.3 percentage points on MATH500 with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 15.8 points on AIME-120 with Qwen3-4B. These results highlight the importance of preserving historical dependencies during calibration for low-bit reasoning.

papers.summary_cn: 论文针对低比特量化严重损害长思维链的问题：推理每一步都要读取跨越数千 token 的 KV 缓存，量化误差会沿轨迹累积，而常规校准只作用于短片段，丢掉了后续推理步骤所需的前文上下文；即便保留上下文，单纯最小化缓存重建误差也无法刻画量化误差如何影响后续注意力。作者提出训练后量化方法 RECAP，用动态前缀校准（dynamic-prefix calibration）把长历史上下文与短块重建分离——用当前量化器重新生成前缀 KV 并轮转活动块，从而监督轨迹上的每个位置，再用前缀读取几何（prefix read geometry）按历史缓存误差对注意力输出的实际影响进行非对称的 key/value 误差加权。两个组件仅在校准阶段生效，在多种推理模型和量化配置下均优于基线。在 W4A4KV4 下，RECAP 使 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 在 MATH500 上提升 13.3 个百分点，使 Qwen3-4B 在 AIME-120 上提升 15.8 个百分点。

papers.title: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at this https URL .

papers.title: GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: this https URL .

papers.title_zh: GAD：用于一致视频生成的几何注意力蒸馏
papers.summary_cn: 论文首先实证当前视频扩散模型的视频注意力无法在帧间建立可靠对应，即使场景结构已经显现，注意力响应仍分散在多个区域，因此难以在结构形成过程中完成跨帧信息交换。作者提出几何注意力蒸馏（GAD），从冻结的几何模型注意力中提取对应关系——这些对应关系在干净视频上提取，可把同一静态表面或同一运动物体跨帧链接起来——并将其蒸馏进视频注意力。由于高噪声时结构在深层开始形成、低噪声时在浅层开始形成，GAD 按噪声时间步选择学生层施加蒸馏。在三个视频骨干上的实验显示长程场景一致性与动态时序一致性同时改善，Wan2.2 5B 上长程基准的跨帧匹配准确率比 Wan 基线至少提升 30%，且推理阶段不引入任何额外模块。

提出几何注意力蒸馏 GAD，将冻结几何模型在干净视频上提取的对应关系（同一静态表面/运动物体）迁移到视频注意力，训练后注意力更稳定地聚焦于对应位置。
设计噪声时间步自适应的学生层选择策略：高噪声选深层、低噪声选浅层，与结构形成的位置匹配。

papers.title: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at this https URL .

papers.title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

papers.title_zh: CineMem：面向多镜头长视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索

papers.title: Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models
papers.abstract: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

papers.title_zh: 面向世界模型中可靠短时域规划的保序潜空间几何
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究潜空间世界模型中按“目标潜变量的终端欧氏距离”为候选动作序列打分排序的可靠性问题。作者指出规划真正需要的并非距离与转移距离完全一致，而是沿转移最短 rollout 上潜距离不出现反转，并证明这一逐路径无反转（pathwise no-reversal）要求正是经典的自逼近（self-approaching）条件；违反它会导致有限时域下精确的候选排序反转。由于视觉世界模型预测的是离散潜序列，作者转而分析其多边形插值，证明一个锐角弯折（acute bend）会形成非空区域：即便 rollout 完全精确，终端欧氏距离也会把“转移上更差”的候选排在真正取得进展的候选之前。作者进一步用经典球面码（spherical-code）界把潜维度解释为角度容量，并设计六分支受控实验（含零填充的三维基线）验证了所预测的排序失效，同时把角度排布的影响与外在维度大小分离开。
innovations: 首次将自逼近性（self-approaching condition）识别为面向规划器的终端欧氏潜规划兼容性条件，并证明其违反等价于有限时域内的精确候选排序反转（pathwise no-reversal 失效）。
针对视觉世界模型输出的离散潜序列，分析其多边形插值几何，证明锐角弯折会产生一个非空区域，在该区域内即使 rollout 完全精确，终端欧氏距离仍会把转移更差的候选排在真正有进展的候选之前。
用经典球面码（spherical-code）上界把潜空间维度解释为角度容量，给出维度与可分辨角度/候选排序可靠性的理论联系。

papers.scenario_cn: 适用于以潜空间世界模型做短时域动作规划的决策系统（视觉世界模型 + 候选动作序列打分排序的规划器），帮助设计者识别并规避因潜空间几何缺陷（锐角弯折、角度容量/维度不足）导致的候选动作排序错误，从而提升规划与决策的可靠性。

papers.title: The Fragility and Dynamics of LLM Pruning-Recovery Steps
papers.abstract: Structural pruning followed by a recovery stage is the standard recipe for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet the two stages are typically designed and tuned in isolation. In this work, we study how their interaction shapes the compressed model, sweeping ordering, the data that drives each stage, and the alignment of their training objectives. We find that instruction-following is the first capability to collapse under pruning, well before knowledge, reasoning, or core language modeling, and that much of the pruning in-domain loss is likely not knowledge loss but a domain-agnostic failure to respond coherently to the prompt. We find in our setting that in-domain data is the strongest pruning signal, whereas instruction-style data recovers the most. Stage order matters little, but only marginally. We further analyze how the importance ranking drifts before and after pruning. Together these results give practitioners a concrete recipe for composing pruning and recovery.

papers.title_zh: LLM 剪枝—恢复步骤的脆弱性与动力学
papers.summary_cn: 论文系统研究了大模型结构化剪枝与恢复训练两阶段之间的相互作用——以往二者常被孤立设计与调参。作者横扫阶段顺序、各阶段所用数据以及对齐训练目标，发现指令跟随能力是剪枝后最先崩溃的能力，远早于知识、推理与基础语言建模能力；剪枝阶段的域内损失很大程度上并非知识丢失，而是一种与领域无关的「无法对提示作出连贯回应」的失败。实验表明域内数据是最强的剪枝信号，而指令风格数据能带来最大的恢复收益；阶段先后顺序影响很小且仅边际有效。论文还分析了剪枝前后重要性排序的漂移，并据此给出组合剪枝与恢复的具体实践配方。

papers.title: GarageWorks: A Shared Testbench Abstraction for Software Simulation and FPGA Testing
papers.abstract: GarageWorks is a lightweight FPGA testing framework that enables the same cocotb testbench to be used for both software RTL simulation and FPGA-accelerated hardware simulation. A shared abstraction hides backend-specific interfaces, while synthesizable Advanced eXtensible Interface (AXI) dispatchers provide design-under-test (DUT)-specific control and test operations on the FPGA. GarageWorks is intended for rapid bare-metal testing of standalone designs and on-chip processing logic for scientific sensors, rather than full SoC-level prototyping. The framework has been validated on AMD Alveo V80 FPGAs with several internal designs and provides initial support for AI-assisted generation of DUT-specific test components.

papers.title: Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

papers.title_zh: 面向低比特 Mamba 超分辨率的硬件友好 Token 分组激活量化

设计轻量分组预测器与离线分组裁剪边界查表机制，仅依赖量化扫描路径之前的 pre-scan 特征，推理阶段不需要运行时统计采集、动态裁剪更新或扫描后分组，保持硬件友好性。
提出 Frequency-Preserving Refinement（FPR）裁剪边界标定目标，对齐全精度教师与量化学生输出的傅里叶幅度与相位，抑制低比特超分的高频结构退化。

papers.title: E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression
papers.abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

提出基于查找表的非对称打分算法，在注意力计算中不做显式码本反量化，从而在 k2v2 下保持与标量基线一致的解码吞吐。
在五个 LLM 系列上验证均匀 2-bit key / 2-bit value 配置可维持接近基线的长上下文困惑度，实现约 6× KV 压缩，比标量 k3v2 再省约 20% 内存。
在完整困惑度评测中于 80% 的模型-数据集-上下文设置上优于标量 k3v2，表明结构化 key 量化可作为扩展质量-内存前沿的低开销原语。
papers.scenario_cn: 用于显存受限的长上下文 LLM 推理服务，让部署方在 2-bit key/value 下仍保持接近全精度的长文本质量，从而在同等显存上支持更长上下文或更高并发。

papers.title: Recovering Low-Bit Failures in Vision-Language-Action Policies via Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Quantization lowers deployment costs of vision-language-action (VLA) policies but can compromise task completion. Across five VLA models and 4,050 real-world trials, we systematically reveal that quantization-aware training (QAT) generally improves on post-training quantization (PTQ) but leaves substantial gaps to full precision (FP) on long-horizon tasks and under visual and semantic shifts, while its imitation-based objective does not explicitly use rollout success or partial completion. To exploit these outcome signals, we introduce Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (QCRL), an offline RL method coupling progress-based advantage estimation with quantization-aware source conditioning. FP rollouts supply reference experience beyond action-level distillation, progress-scaled terminal penalty distinguishes partial completion, and quantization-aware conditioning selects advantageous reference behavior within the quantized policy. We evaluate weight-only INT4 W4A16 on $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 and joint weight-activation NVFP4 W4A4 on $\pi_{0.5}$. Using only in-distribution data, QCRL reaches 99.3% of FP's mean score across three visual-shift conditions for $\pi_{0.5}$ with INT4 W4A16, alongside 42.9% model-memory savings. With NVFP4 W4A4, it reaches 100.7% of the same FP baseline, alongside a $1.73\times$ speedup using NVFP4/FP8 deployment. Hardware gains are relative to FP16 on Jetson Thor.

papers.title_zh: 通过量化条件强化学习恢复视觉-语言-动作策略的低位宽失效
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对 VLA 策略量化后任务完成率下降的问题，在 5 个 VLA 模型、4,050 次真实世界试验中系统评测，发现量化感知训练（QAT）总体优于训练后量化（PTQ），但在长时程任务以及视觉和语义分布偏移下仍与全精度（FP）存在明显差距，而其模仿式目标并未显式利用 rollout 成功率或部分完成信号。为此作者提出 Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning（QCRL）：一种离线强化学习方法，把基于进度的优势估计与量化感知源条件化耦合，用 FP rollout 提供超出动作级蒸馏的参考经验，用进度缩放的终局惩罚区分部分完成，并用量化感知条件化在量化策略内部选择有利的参考行为。实验在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 上评测 weight-only INT4 W4A16、在 π0.5 上评测权重-激活联合 NVFP4 W4A4：仅用分布内数据，INT4 W4A16 下 π0.5 在三种视觉偏移条件下达到 FP 平均得分的 99.3% 并节省 42.9% 模型显存，NVFP4 W4A4 下达到 FP 基线的 100.7% 且借助 NVFP4/FP8 部署取得 1.73× 加速（硬件收益相对 Jetson Thor 上的 FP16）。
innovations: 提出 QCRL，将基于进度的优势估计与量化感知源条件化相结合，用离线 RL 显式利用 rollout 成功与部分完成等结果信号，弥补 QAT 模仿目标不直接优化任务完成度的缺陷。
以 FP rollout 充当参考经验而非仅做动作级蒸馏，并用进度缩放的终局惩罚区分部分完成，使量化策略在长时程任务上更接近全精度。
在 5 个 VLA 模型、4,050 次真实世界试验上系统揭示 QAT 相对 PTQ 的改进以及在长时程与视觉/语义偏移下的残余精度差距。
仅用分布内数据即在 π0.5 + INT4 W4A16 上达到 FP 平均得分的 99.3%（省 42.9% 模型显存），在 NVFP4 W4A4 下达到 100.7% 并获得 1.73× 加速（相对 Jetson Thor FP16）。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向机器人与具身智能场景中 VLA 策略的低成本/端侧部署，在量化压缩显存、提升推理速度的同时，保证长时程任务及视觉、语义扰动下的任务成功率接近全精度模型。

papers.title: EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity
papers.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video-text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs. Prompts that explicitly describe a character's emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

papers.title_zh: EmoTrace-Bench：通过受控线索与强度诊断文本到视频生成中的情绪表达
papers.summary_cn: 论文关注 T2V 模型情绪表达评测的粗粒度问题：现有方法多依赖整体视频-文本对齐分数，无法区分失败究竟来自目标情绪表达、强度控制还是具体情感线索。作者提出 EmoTrace-Bench，一个在提示中同时控制情绪强度与选定情感线索的细粒度诊断基准，包含 448 条受控提示，覆盖 8 种情绪、2 个强度等级及多样化线索条件；用 12 个 T2V 模型生成 5,376 段视频，并从目标情绪是否出现、感知强度、以及 10 个情绪表达视听维度进行评估，其中自动评估器在部分数据上经人工标注校准与验证。结果显示模型与提示设计间差异显著：显式描述角色情绪反应的提示比仅描述事件或场景的提示更可靠地生效，而增加情感线索或使用更明确的电影化视听语言并不能稳定提升情绪生成，说明聚合对齐分数会掩盖目标情绪表达、强度控制与线索实现上的局部差异。
innovations: 构建 EmoTrace-Bench 细粒度诊断基准：448 条受控提示，系统控制情绪强度（2 档）与情感线索条件，覆盖 8 种情绪，可在不修改生成管线的前提下做可追溯、可解释的诊断。
设计多层评估协议，分别考察目标情绪是否出现、感知强度以及 10 个视听维度的情绪表达，并提供一个经人工标注子集校准与验证的自动评估器；规模上使用 12 个 T2V 模型生成 5,376 段视频。
实证发现提示设计效应不均衡：显式描述角色情绪反应的提示比只描述事件或场景的提示更可靠，而叠加更多情感线索或改用更电影化的视听语言并不稳定提升情绪生成。
揭示聚合式视频-文本对齐分数会掩盖局部差异——情绪表达、强度控制、线索实现上的失败需分层指标才能暴露，并公开提示词与自动评估规则。
papers.scenario_cn: 用于 T2V 模型情绪表达能力的评测与选型：帮助开发者和内容创作者定位情绪生成失败的成因（目标情绪缺失、强度不受控或线索未实现），适用于视频生成模型对齐评估、剧情/广告类情绪化短视频生成的质量诊断场景。

papers.title: Online Batching with Lookahead: Adversarial Limits and Stochastic Gains
papers.abstract: Modern inference systems rely on batching to exploit parallel execution and amortize serial execution overheads, but batching creates a fundamental online scheduling tradeoff: serving requests immediately reduces request queuing delay, while waiting can form larger batches that better utilize parallel hardware and improve serving efficiency. We study this tradeoff in a single-server online batching model with bounded batch capacity, fixed batch processing time, and the objective of minimizing total flow time. Our focus is on the value of finite lookahead into future arrivals over a purely online setting for scheduling. We show that the benefits of lookahead depend on the arrival model. In the adversarial setting, finite perfect lookahead has inherent limitations: for any bounded lookahead window, every online algorithm remains separated from the offline optimum by a constant factor. Thus, worst-case arrival sequences can prevent perfect knowledge of future events from fully overcoming online uncertainty. In contrast, under Poisson arrivals in the stable regime, finite lookahead is much more powerful. Although the best distribution-aware online algorithm has a nonzero asymptotic gap from the offline optimum, lookahead closes this gap exponentially fast in the window length. We prove matching upper and lower bounds up to constants in the exponent. Together, these results give a tight characterization of when lookahead can close the online--offline gap, incorporating insights from the competitive analysis of online algorithms into queueing-theoretic steady-state bounds. We also study imperfect predictions, showing that the benefit of lookahead degrades gracefully with prediction error. Simulations on synthetic arrivals and experiments on real request traces support the theory: modest lookahead substantially reduces flow time and brings online batching close to the offline benchmark.

papers.title_zh: 带前瞻的在线批处理：对抗性极限与随机性收益
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究单服务器在线批处理模型（批容量有界、批处理时间固定、目标为最小化总流时间）中，有限前瞻（lookahead）相对纯在线调度的价值，并指出其收益取决于到达模型。在对抗性到达下，任何有界前瞻窗口的在线算法仍与离线最优相差常数因子，即使完美预知未来也无法完全消除在线不确定性；而在稳定区间的泊松到达下，前瞻极为有效，可将分布感知在线算法与离线最优之间非零的渐近间隙以随窗口长度指数级的速度收敛填补，并给出指数常数意义下匹配的上界与下界。论文还分析了不完美预测，表明前瞻收益随预测误差平滑退化；合成到达仿真与真实请求轨迹实验显示，适度前瞻即可显著降低流时间并使在线批处理逼近离线基准。
innovations: 将在线算法的竞争分析与排队论稳态界结合，给出前瞻能否填补在线-离线间隙的紧致刻画：对抗到达下证明任意有界前瞻窗口都存在常数因子分离下界，泊松稳定区间则证明前瞻收益随窗口长度指数收敛，并给出指数常数意义下匹配的上下界。
首次区分到达模型刻画前瞻能力上界：证明最坏情况到达序列下“完美预知未来”不足以突破常数因子分离，说明有限前瞻在对抗设置中本质受限。
在稳定区间泊松到达下刻画前瞻收益的指数收敛速率，为“等待凑批 vs. 立即响应”的收益给出闭式渐近规律。
分析不完美预测下的前瞻收益，证明其随预测误差平滑退化，并用合成到达与真实请求轨迹实验验证理论：适度前瞻显著降低流时间并逼近离线最优。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向以批处理提升吞吐的 LLM 推理服务等在线调度系统，为调度器在“立即响应”与“等待凑批”之间的取舍提供理论依据：当可获得少量未来到达信息（预测或有限前瞻）时，指导等待窗口与批容量的设置以降低请求排队/流时间。

papers.title: VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment
papers.abstract: Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.

papers.title: Avoiding What Your Teacher Already Knows: Entity Familiarity for Deep-Search Distillation
papers.abstract: Deep-search agents are commonly trained by distilling tool-use trajectories from stronger teacher models. However, structurally complex questions may remain relatively easy for teachers familiar with key entities in the underlying entity graph, resulting in lower search demand and weaker supervision. We refer to this teacher-specific variation in question difficulty as teacher-relative difficulty and investigate entity familiarity as an early predictor. We first introduce Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity (EVF), which estimates familiarity by verifying a teacher-generated factual brief against online evidence. Across multiple teachers, EVF is significantly correlated with teacher-relative difficulty with AUCs of 0.60--0.70. However, its high cost makes it impractical for constructing entity graphs at scale. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Reported Entity Familiarity (SEF), a lightweight gating signal that directly asks a teacher whether it is familiar with an entity before admitting that entity into the graph. Across multiple teachers, trajectories from SEF-gated synthesis exhibit greater observed search demand and yield higher downstream student accuracy than those from ungated synthesis. Because familiarity is teacher specific, we further study cross-teacher reuse. We screen graphs collected for other teachers using Kimi-K3's SEF judgments and use the retained graphs to produce 5,411 additional trajectories. Combined with 2,200 trajectories from newly constructed, SEF-gated graphs, these data improve Qwen3.8-27B's accuracy from 44.10% to 66.41% on a BrowseComp subset, and achieving state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable size on BrowseComp, SEAL-0, HLE-text, and xbench. Overall, SEF provides a low-cost way to synthesize more informative supervision for deep-search distillation.

papers.title_zh: 避开教师已经掌握的内容：面向深度搜索蒸馏的实体熟悉度

提出 EVF（Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity）：通过将教师生成的事实简述与在线检索证据做核验来估计熟悉度，在多个教师上以 AUC 0.60–0.70 预测 teacher-relative difficulty，验证了实体熟悉度可作为早期可测指标。

papers.scenario_cn: 适用于构建和训练具备工具调用与多跳检索能力的深度搜索代理（如联网问答、深度研究助手）的团队，用于低成本提升蒸馏数据的监督密度和信息量；也可用于跨教师模型复用已有的实体图与轨迹资产，降低为每个教师单独造数据的开销。

papers.title: CircuitBreak: Pruning a Sparse Safety Circuit of Neurons
papers.abstract: White-box neuron pruning has shown that refusal in large language models (LLMs) can depend on a small, removable set of feed-forward (FFN) channels. Existing attacks either need carefully paired ``twin'' prompts or score each neuron in isolation. Pruning also has an unavoidable capability cost, so over-removal compounds the loss. TwinBreak removes $1\%$--$5\%$ of parameters and NeuroStrike removes $0.3\%$--$0.7\%$ of neurons in targeted layers. We model safety as a small \emph{circuit} whose neurons contribute jointly rather than independently. We propose \textsc{CircuitBreak}, a neuron-pruning attack that greedily searches for a sparse set of FFN neurons whose joint ablation flips a refusal readout. \textsc{CircuitBreak} re-scores every candidate after the neurons already removed and needs no twin prompts. On ten instruction-tuned models, the greedy search converges after removing $29$--$150$ neurons ($0.0066\%$--$0.0388\%$ of the MLP). The pruned models raise the attack success rate from $2.24\%$/$7.35\%$ to $87.54\%$/$87.54\%$ on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from $8.95\%$/$5.43\%$ to $88.50\%$/$88.18\%$ on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, as judged by Llama Guard 3 8B on StrongREJECT.

papers.title_zh: CircuitBreak：剪枝一个稀疏的安全神经元回路
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究大模型白盒神经元剪枝攻击：已有工作表明拒绝（refusal）行为依赖少量可移除的前馈网络（FFN）通道，但 TwinBreak 需精心构造配对“孪生”提示，NeuroStrike 则孤立地给单个神经元打分，且剪枝不可避免带来能力损失，过度移除会叠加损伤。作者把安全机制建模为一个“回路”（circuit），认为其中神经元的贡献是联合而非独立的，据此提出 CircuitBreak：不依赖孪生提示，通过贪心搜索一组稀疏的 FFN 神经元，使其联合消融后能够翻转拒绝读出，并且在已移除部分神经元后会重新为所有候选打分。在十个指令微调模型上，贪心搜索移除 29–150 个神经元（仅占 MLP 的 0.0066%–0.0388%）即收敛；由 Llama Guard 3 8B 在 StrongREJECT 上判定，Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的攻击成功率从 2.24%/7.35% 升到 87.54%/87.54%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 从 8.95%/5.43% 升到 88.50%/88.18%。

提出 CircuitBreak 贪心剪枝攻击：搜索一组稀疏 FFN 神经元使其联合消融即可翻转拒绝读出，且不依赖 TwinBreak 所必需的配对孪生提示，降低了攻击构造门槛。
采用“移除后重打分”的迭代策略：每移除一个神经元后重新评估所有剩余候选，避免因神经元间耦合导致的评分失效与冗余剪枝，在十个指令微调模型上均于 29–150 个神经元（MLP 的 0.0066%–0.0388%）内收敛。

papers.title: LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

papers.title: CoverSynth: Coverage-Guided Generation of Retrieval Evaluation Sets
papers.abstract: Enterprise agents need retrieval evaluation sets that expose domain-specific failures and guide developers towards efficient deployment tradeoffs. Neither expert-human-authored sets nor current synthetic generation methods provide a methodology for achieving the necessary coverage, reliability, efficiency, and discriminability required for such decision-making. Simultaneously, the field does not have an assessment framework for determining when an evaluation set has satisfied these properties. We introduce an evaluation set assessment framework for these criteria and CoverSynth -- a generator specifically designed to satisfy these criteria without incurring the high cost of human expert labeling. Starting from an unannotated corpus, CoverSynth targets coverage across retrieval demands and system capabilities. Deterministic checks locate evidence quotes in their sources, while model-based checks assess semantic validity to guarantee reliable ground truth. Across five public enterprise-style corpora, our method provides informative variation in difficulty, revealing unseen failure modes such as an inability of agents to handle underspecified or ambiguous requests. On the RepLiQA corpus, 91\% of human-generated queries can be answered by all members on a panel of 12 retrieval systems, compared to only 12\% of CoverSynth-generated queries. Finally, in a repeated TechQA/RepLiQA study, 12 of 12 within-harness model contrasts have positive nominal 95\% intervals on generated sets, compared with 4 of 12 on human sets. CoverSynth makes coverage and evidence quality explicit construction objectives, producing corpus-grounded evaluations that reveal retrieval headroom and differences between agent configurations.

papers.title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
papers.abstract: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.

papers.title: AegisAsync: Symbolic Async-Event Simulation for Risks in Python Asynchronous Programs
papers.abstract: Security and robustness risks in Python async programs depend on event order, object identity, and execution after exceptions or cancellation. Detecting these risks requires connecting related operations across function calls and tracking their effects along execution paths. We present AegisAsync, a bytecode-based analysis of Python async risks for CPython 3.10-3.14. Its Async Event Transition Graph combines bytecode control flow, resolved calls, async events, and symbolic object relations. Bounded path-local simulation tracks event order and object states and explores cancellation at await suspensions. Six detector plugins evaluate the resulting traces and states to produce candidates with supporting witnesses. On AsyncBench, our benchmark of 180 labeled risks, AegisAsync detects all labeled risks with zero false positives on each of the five versions. Across five path budgets on 2,500 PyPI package versions, source review confirms 457 of 910 AegisAsync candidate records (50.2%), representing 457 unique bugs; across three flake8-async samples, 70 of 2,187 review judgments are confirmed (3.2%). By submission, 166 PoCs reproduce AegisAsync findings, and we have reported 157 bugs to developers, of which 16 have been confirmed and fixed.

papers.title: An Open MuJoCo Simulation Framework for a Quadrotor Carrying a Tendon-Driven Soft Continuum Arm
papers.abstract: Combining aerial robots with soft continuum manipulators promises safe, compliant interaction with the environment, but the coupled dynamics of a free-flying base and a highly deformable, underactuated arm are difficult to study without a suitable simulator. This paper describes an open-source simulation framework, built on the MuJoCo physics engine, for a quadrotor that carries a tendon-driven soft continuum arm underneath its body. The arm is modelled as a pseudo-rigid-body chain of twelve segments joined by pairs of orthogonal compliant hinges. Three tendons, spaced \SI{120}{\degree} apart and routed through every segment, bend it in any direction. A geometric tracking controller on $SE(3)$ flies the vehicle; its rotor allocation matrix is generated directly from the model description. A closed-form tendon-tension allocation keeps every tension within its limits and gives the same bending moment in every direction. We report the full set of modelling choices and parameters, and we evaluate the framework in four simulated scenarios: a \SI{36}{\second} mission with a figure-eight and a tendon-driven tip sweep, an attitude-gain study, a quasi-static characterization of the bending workspace, and an impulsive disturbance applied to the arm tip. With the nominal gains the vehicle tracks the mission with \SI{3.1}{\centi\meter} RMS position error while the arm tip swings up to \SI{37}{\centi\meter} from the body axis. The gain study shows that a low-bandwidth attitude loop lets the arm excite sustained oscillations. The simulation runs about $15\times$ faster than real time on a laptop CPU. All models, controllers and scripts that reproduce the figures are released.

papers.title: ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation
papers.abstract: Medication recommendation requires jointly considering diagnoses, comorbidities, longitudinal patient history, and treatment interactions. Although recent retrieval-augmented generation approaches using language models have shown promise for clinical recommendation, most existing systems rely on fixed retrieval pipelines that cannot adapt to diverse clinical retrieval scenarios and may introduce noisy or irrelevant evidence. We propose ARMED, an adaptive clinical RAG framework that dynamically expands retrieval according to retrieval sufficiency and current-admission relevance. ARMED first observes the initial retrieval outcome and selectively performs supplementary or fallback multi-query retrieval when additional evidence is needed. The framework also incorporates a relevance gate that activates only clinically relevant same-patient history and organizes retrieved evidence into structured query-level clinical evidence. Experiments on MIMIC-IV demonstrate that ARMED consistently outperforms previous static retrieval baselines and improves overall medication recommendation quality. By combining locally runnable small language models with adaptive retrieval, ARMED supports medication recommendation without relying on external language model APIs or task-specific fine-tuning.

papers.title: Adaptive Event-Triggered Model Predictive Coverage Control with Average Update-Rate Regulation
papers.abstract: Model predictive coverage control for multi-agent systems operates under tight communication and computation budgets, which requires it to balance the load of optimization against responsiveness to varying spatial priorities. With a fixed event threshold, the update rate varies with operating conditions, making a prescribed average update budget difficult to maintain. We propose threshold-adaptive event-triggered model predictive control (MPC), which adjusts the threshold online in proportion to the difference between the target average period and the latest inter-event interval. We prove convergence of the empirical average update period to any feasible prescribed target and establish initialization-dependent one-sided bounds on the cumulative average. A nonlinear benchmark illustrates these budget guarantees. We then apply the mechanism to coverage MPC using a task-aware statistic that captures robot motion and changes in spatial importance. In a five-agent moving-density study, the adaptive policy uses 204.7 global MPC updates on average against a target of 200, compared with 266.7 for a fixed-threshold policy using the same statistic and initial threshold. It also reduces coverage cost relative to periodic schedules with exactly matched update counts. These results demonstrate direct average-budget regulation and effective task-dependent scheduling of MPC updates.

papers.title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
papers.abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

papers.title: AiSAQ-in-Filtering for DRAM-free Filtered Information Retrieval
papers.abstract: Filtering search is one of the crucial applications of approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). In filtering search, label information is used in conjunction with unstructured vector data. ANNS provides efficient similarity search in large-scale datasets, however, the memory footprint of storing both vector data and their associated label becomes a significant cost factor as dataset sizes grow. To address this problem of increasing DRAM usage, we propose AiSAQ-in-Filtering, with a novel quantization method called LiPQ (Label-inclusive Product Quantization). LiPQ combines unstructured data and structured labels into a single representation, leading no growth of encoded data. Our proposal increased recall@1 of single-label searches by up to 55% and fewer disk I/Os compared with existing methods. This also retains the main advantages of AiSAQ, which can reduce DRAM footprint by up to 1/78 and index switching time comparing with existing methods. This proposal can also be applied to sparse-dense hybrid search beyond label filtering such as semantic and keyword search of documents.

papers.title_zh: 面向无 DRAM 过滤式信息检索的 AiSAQ-in-Filtering
papers.summary_cn: 针对过滤式近似最近邻搜索（filtering search）中向量数据与标签并存导致 DRAM 占用随规模膨胀的问题，论文提出 AiSAQ-in-Filtering 及其量化方法 LiPQ（Label-inclusive Product Quantization），将非结构化向量与结构化标签融合进单一表示，使编码数据量不因标签而增长。实验显示单标签检索的 recall@1 最高提升 55%，磁盘 I/O 少于既有方法，同时保留 AiSAQ 的核心优势：DRAM 占用最多降低至 1/78，并缩短索引切换时间。该方案还可推广到标签过滤之外的稀疏-稠密混合检索，如文档的语义与关键词联合搜索。
innovations: 提出 LiPQ（Label-inclusive Product Quantization）：把结构化标签与非结构化向量编码进同一表示，标签不额外增加编码体积。
构建 AiSAQ-in-Filtering，在无 DRAM（DRAM-free）假设下完成过滤式 ANNS，单标签搜索 recall@1 相比现有方法最高提升 55%。
在保持召回提升的同时减少磁盘 I/O，并把 DRAM 占用最多压缩到 1/78，且缩短索引切换时间。
方法不局限于标签过滤，可扩展至稀疏-稠密混合检索（语义+关键词的文档检索）场景。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于超大规模向量检索系统中带标签/属性过滤的相似性搜索，以及内存受限、需在磁盘驻留索引上运行的服务端检索；也适用于文档语义检索与关键词检索融合的混合搜索业务。

papers.title: Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation
papers.abstract: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

papers.title_zh: 通过测试却丢失语义：基于计划的 DataFrame 代码生成中「解释锁定」现象的证据
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究「先规划→再实现→再修订」这类代码生成流程中的一种失效模式：模型对任务的一次错误理解会沿计划、实现、测试一路固化下来，作者称之为「解释锁定」（interpretive lock-in）。在 30 个取自 TPC Benchmark DS 的 DataFrame 任务上，作者对比了三种流水线：冻结单次生成（Frozen One-Pass）、测试引导修订（Test-Guided Revision）与 PlanAudit 引导修订；测试通过数由 22/30 提升到 29/30、再到 30/30，但没有任何一个生成解与其存储的参考输出一致。为排除「是评测本身失效」这一解释，作者设置了三重对照：评测器控制在 57/57 例中给出预期结果，同引擎重执行 SQL 可复现 28/30 条参考结果，而在这批任务上全部 77 次「测试通过」的运行仍未能与参考结果达成一致。PlanAudit 引导修订的收益有限：仅在 3/30 个任务上提升代码评分、11/30 个任务上提升测试覆盖率，两项指标的配对变化中位数均为 0。失败分析归纳出自生成测试的四类缺陷：遗漏需求、采用候选自身定义的 schema、使用无区分力的测试数据（fixture）、以及复述实现中错误的逻辑。对十个针对性任务重新生成时，0/30 与参考输出匹配，且在通过测试的运行中 25/25 全是假通过。作者明确说明该研究属诊断性质而非因果结论：三条流水线在反馈形式、接地信息、调用预算和编辑权限上均不同，且仅使用单一模型、每个合格任务只做一次主生成；由于未保留裁决前的人工标注，无法重建评分者间一致性，机制分析只能视为探索性的。
papers.innovations: 1) 提出并量化「解释锁定」（interpretive lock-in）这一新的失效模式：规划与修订本意是让代码更贴近任务规范，实测却把早期的错误解释稳定地固化到计划、实现与测试中。2) 构建三重反证式对照来排除评测噪声——评测器控制 57/57 正确、同引擎 SQL 重执行复现 28/30 参考结果、77 次通过测试的运行全部与参考不一致——从而让「测试通过≠语义正确」这一结论站得住脚。3) 系统归纳自生成测试的四类失效机制（遗漏需求、沿用候选自定 schema、无区分力 fixture、复述实现的错误逻辑），可用于诊断同类流水线。4) 指出计划审计类反馈（PlanAudit）收益有限（代码分 3/30、覆盖率 11/30、配对变化中位数为 0），挑战「更结构化的反馈必然有效」的直觉。5) 给出假通过率这一可直接用于评估设计的量化指标（针对性重生成中 25/25 假通过），并如实披露研究局限（单模型、单次生成、不可重建的评分者一致性）。
papers.scenario_cn: 适用于 LLM 代码生成与 Code Agent 的评测体系设计，尤其是把自生成测试或执行反馈当作正确性判据的自动编程流水线；也适用于 Text-to-SQL 与 DataFrame 数据变换类代码生成、以及生产环境中以「测试全绿」作为完成信号、据此放行提交的编码代理与 CI 自动修复场景。其价值在于提醒研究者和工程团队：绿色测试并不等于语义对齐，需要引入独立参考实现、接地数据或人工裁决等手段来补充验证。

papers.title: SpecCloak: Probing Harmful Code Generation through Engineering Specifications
papers.abstract: The code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) can equally be misused to implement harmful functionality, underscoring the need to understand their safety behavior in response to programming requests. While request phrasing is known to influence refusal, it remains unclear whether the form in which coding task requirements are stated affects the refusal process for malicious code generation. We introduce PseudoSpec, a template that organizes functional requirements as engineering specifications, and investigate its effects through controlled comparisons, representation analysis, and activation interventions. Across five open-weight models, removing explicit risk keywords only partially reduces refusal, whereas specification prompting substantially lowers refusal even when these keywords are retained. This reduction accompanies consistent shifts toward code-output-related representations, and interventions along condition-difference directions alter refusal behavior. Output analysis further distinguishes code-related responses from generation degeneration. Building on these findings, we propose SpecCloak, a black-box red-teaming framework combining PseudoSpec with discriminator-guided optimization, achieving an average execution-verified attack success rate of 28.91\% across eight target models on RedCode-Gen. We also introduce SpecReveal, a defense prototype combining natural-language intent reconstruction with dual-view detection without target-model fine-tuning. It achieves a 96.88\% attack detection rate in a separate prompt-detection evaluation, with false positives assessed on benign programming and specification-style inputs. These results connect specification-induced response differences to practical security consequences and identify intent reconstruction as a complementary detection approach.

papers.title_zh: SpecCloak：通过工程规格说明书探测有害代码生成
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究一个此前被忽视的问题：LLM 生成恶意代码时的拒答行为，是否受“编码任务需求以何种形式陈述”影响。作者提出 PseudoSpec 模板，把功能性需求重新组织为工程规格说明书（engineering specification）的写法，并通过受控对比、表征分析与激活干预三条线展开验证。在五个开源权重模型上发现：仅删除显式风险关键词只能部分降低拒答率，而一旦改用规格化提示，即使把这些风险关键词原样保留，拒答率也会大幅下降；这种下降同时伴随模型内部表征持续向“代码输出相关”方向偏移，且沿条件差异方向施加激活干预可以定向改变拒答行为。作者进一步分析输出，把真正生成代码的响应与生成退化（乱码/退化输出）区分开。基于上述机制，论文提出黑盒红队框架 SpecCloak，将 PseudoSpec 与判别器引导的优化搜索结合，在 RedCode-Gen 基准上对八个目标模型取得平均 28.91% 的执行验证攻击成功率（ASR）。防御侧提出原型 SpecReveal，把自然语言意图重建与双视角检测结合，无需对目标模型做任何微调，在独立的提示检测评测中达到 96.88% 的攻击检测率，并在良性编程与规格风格输入上评估误报。
papers.innovations: 1) 提出 PseudoSpec 规格化提示模板，首次系统证明恶意代码生成的拒答行为主要由“需求陈述形式”而非风险关键词触发，风险关键词被保留时拒答仍显著塌陷；2) 给出机制层证据：规格提示使模型表征向代码输出方向偏移，并可沿“条件差异方向”做激活干预来双向操控拒答，把行为现象与内部表征打通；3) 提出区分“代码相关响应”与“生成退化”的输出分析方法，避免把退化输出误判为攻击成功；4) 黑盒红队框架 SpecCloak（PseudoSpec + 判别器引导优化），在八个目标模型上达到平均 28.91% 执行验证 ASR，不依赖权重访问；5) 防御原型 SpecReveal（自然语言意图重建 + 双视角检测），免目标模型微调，提示检测攻击识别率 96.88%，并配套评估正常编程与规格输入下的误报。
papers.scenario_cn: 面向 LLM 代码生成的安全对齐、红队评估与防护落地：安全团队可用 SpecCloak 对代码助手（IDE Copilot、代码生成 API、SWE/Code Agent）做自动化越狱式审计，检验安全策略在“把恶意需求写成工程规格”这类规避手法下是否失效；模型与平台方可在不暴露、不微调权重的前提下部署 SpecReveal 做提示级恶意意图检测与拦截；对研究侧则提供了一个“提示形式 → 内部表征 → 拒答行为”的可解释分析范式，可用于改进对齐训练与安全评测协议。适用于模型供应商、AI 安全实验室、企业代码平台的安全合规环节。
